     6  module
     7  
     8  public import Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplexCategory.Basic
     9  public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.PathCategory.Basic
    10  /-! # Presentation of the simplex category by generators and relations.
    11  
    12  We introduce `SimplexCategoryGenRel` as the category presented by generating
    13  morphisms `δ i : [n] ⟶ [n + 1]` and `σ i : [n + 1] ⟶ [n]` and subject to the
    14  simplicial identities, and we provide induction principles for reasoning about
    15  objects and morphisms in this category.
    16  
    17  This category admits a canonical functor `toSimplexCategory` to the usual simplex category.
    18  The fact that this functor is an equivalence will be recorded in a separate file.
    19  -/
    20  
    21  @[expose] public section
    22  open CategoryTheory
    23  
    24  /-- The objects of the free simplex quiver are the natural numbers. -/
    25  def FreeSimplexQuiver := ℕ
    26  
    27  /-- Making an object of `FreeSimplexQuiver` out of a natural number. -/
    28  def FreeSimplexQuiver.mk (n : ℕ) : FreeSimplexQuiver := n
    29  
    30  /-- Getting back the natural number from the objects. -/
    31  def FreeSimplexQuiver.len (x : FreeSimplexQuiver) : ℕ := x
    32  
    33  namespace FreeSimplexQuiver
    34  
    35  /-- A morphism in `FreeSimplexQuiver` is either a face map (`δ`) or a degeneracy map (`σ`). -/
    36  inductive Hom : FreeSimplexQuiver → FreeSimplexQuiver → Type
    37    | δ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 2)) : Hom (.mk n) (.mk (n + 1))
    38    | σ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Hom (.mk (n + 1)) (.mk n)
    39  
    40  instance quiv : Quiver FreeSimplexQuiver where
    41    Hom := FreeSimplexQuiver.Hom
    42  
    43  /-- `FreeSimplexQuiver.δ i` represents the `i`-th face map `.mk n ⟶ .mk (n + 1)`. -/
    44  abbrev δ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 2)) : FreeSimplexQuiver.mk n ⟶ .mk (n + 1) :=
    45    FreeSimplexQuiver.Hom.δ i
    46  
    47  /-- `FreeSimplexQuiver.σ i` represents `i`-th degeneracy map `.mk (n + 1) ⟶ .mk n`. -/
    48  abbrev σ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) : FreeSimplexQuiver.mk (n + 1) ⟶ .mk n :=
    49    FreeSimplexQuiver.Hom.σ i
    50  
    51  /-- `FreeSimplexQuiver.homRel` is the relation on morphisms freely generated on the
    52  five simplicial identities. -/
    53  inductive homRel : HomRel (Paths FreeSimplexQuiver)
    54    | δ_comp_δ {n : ℕ} {i j : Fin (n + 2)} (H : i ≤ j) : homRel
    55      ((Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (δ i) ≫ (Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (δ j.succ))
    56      ((Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (δ j) ≫ (Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (δ i.castSucc))
    57    | δ_comp_σ_of_le {n : ℕ} {i : Fin (n + 2)} {j : Fin (n + 1)} (H : i ≤ j.castSucc) : homRel
    58      ((Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (δ i.castSucc) ≫ (Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (σ j.succ))
    59      ((Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (σ j) ≫ (Paths.of FreeSimplexQuiver).map (δ i))
    60    | δ_comp_σ_self {n : ℕ} {i : Fin (n + 1)} : homRel
